legend.planned: Planned or researched, not available yet

items.feature: Kohn-Sham DFT with plane waves
items.note: Periodic NC plane-wave Kohn–Sham DFT; unpolarized and supported collinear sectors, with documented occupation/XC limits.

items.feature: LDA (Perdew-Zunger) and PBE (GGA)
items.note: PBE comes from the xcx library; tested against QE on the same pseudopotential.

items.feature: Insulators with fixed occupations
items.note: Fixed occupations require a sampled band gap. Use the separate Fermi-Dirac option for partial occupations.

items.feature: Gamma, Monkhorst-Pack grids (shifted or not), explicit k lists
items.note: Time reversal and opt-in crystal symmetry reduction; only model-, mesh- and FFT-grid-preserving operations. [Evidence](tests/reference/symmetry/evidence.json).

items.feature: Broyden/plain density mixing and reference Davidson
items.note: Broyden/plain density mixing and reference Davidson; beta 0.7/history 8, threshold 5e-9 Ha and verification on by default. StrictOracle is an explicit validation route and the temporary G4D fallback. Verified standard is not strict-certified.

items.feature: One TOML file; units (Ha, Ry, eV, Angstrom, Bohr, ...) and expressions such as 1/4 or 5.43/2 Angstrom
items.note: Wrong inputs are rejected with the key path of the problem.

items.feature: results.json (energies, eigenvalues, convergence history, provenance) and the electron density (binary + metadata)
items.note: Every run records input and pseudopotential hashes.

items.feature: Thread budget and determinism
items.note: Thread budget via [scf] threads = N (default 1); same-build/backend determinism is checked separately from MPI rank-count accuracy. Reference k/spin/FD work is distributed under MPI.

items.feature: Agrees with Quantum ESPRESSO 7.6 on silicon (energies, eigenvalues, k grids, PBE)
items.note: See the validation results below. One cell and one pseudopotential so far.

items.feature: Band structures and density of states (CSV, SVG figure, QE-/VASP-style files)
items.note: `bands` and `dos` subcommands: CSV, SVG, QE- and VASP-style files. Fixed-density non-self-consistent calculation; checked by the repository tests.

items.feature: Electron density, ELF and potentials as cube, XSF, CHGCAR and VTK files
items.note: Cube, XSF, CHGCAR and VTK writers; opens in VESTA, VMD, ParaView and similar viewers. Checked against format specifications in tests.

items.feature: Reference convergence and historical buffer-band recovery
items.note: Reference convergence uses its Davidson Ritz-change schedule, Broyden mixing and independent verification. Historical buffer-band recovery is oracle evidence; it is not a production tuning recipe.

items.feature: Input preflight check: element versus pseudopotential, SCF settings, plain-language summary of what will be computed
items.note: `validate` checks element versus pseudopotential and SCF settings and prints a plain-language summary; no SCF is run.

items.feature: Optional Intel MKL backend for FFT and matrix products, chosen at compile time
items.note: Optional Intel MKL FFT/matrix backend is implemented behind a compile-time feature; the default build is pure Rust. See dated same-model dev08 tables for end-to-end measurements and their limits.

items.feature: Opt-in reference RMM, reference ladder and plain/TF preconditioning
items.note: Reference RMM and reference ladder remain isolated opt-in algorithms; reference preconditioning is plain or TF. Adopted reference rollback branches and rejected experiments were retired under D3; retained choices are listed in the current switch manifest.

items.feature: Structure and input importers, Materials Project lookup, pseudopotential download with license and hash checks, a guided or natural-language style CLI
items.note: In design now.

items.feature: General benchmark and robustness suite (not silicon-only)
items.note: Used to judge speed and defaults on many cell shapes, band counts and pseudopotentials.

items.feature: Reference runtime, checkpoint v2, Python/ASE and host-embedded MCP
items.note: Reference stepper/runtime, observed and supervised CLI, checkpoint v2, Python stepping and host-embedded MCP are implemented with documented limits. Legacy budget-recovery evidence remains historical; reference budget-extension recovery is unsupported. Numerical core has no LLM/network dependency.

items.feature: Offline pseudopotential registry with license and SHA-256 checks
items.note: `pseudo` subcommands; pseudopotential files are never shipped in the repository.

items.feature: Fermi-Dirac occupations and chemical potential
items.note: Fermi–Dirac occupations and chemical potential for supported unpolarized/collinear models, with limited validation and empty-band checks. Reference fixed-cutoff electronic steppers support exact checkpoint v2; warm imports and legacy v1 FD restart remain unavailable. Free-moment PBE uses the G4D oracle fallback. Analytic synthetic oracles and an Al smoke run; no QE metal comparison. [Evidence](tests/reference/occupations/summary.json).

items.feature: Collinear spin with fixed up/down electron counts
items.note: LDA-PW and PBE; synthetic analytic and zero-moment oracles. No validated magnetic material ground state; noncollinear and spin-orbit remain unavailable. [Evidence](crates/dft-engine/tests/collinear-evidence.json).

items.feature: Grimme DFT-D3 dispersion (BJ and zero damping)
items.note: Optional build (`--features dftd3`) that loads the official simple-dftd3 1.7.0 library at run time; added to energy, forces, stress and relaxation after the SCF. Matches the s-dftd3 program to 1e-16 Ha and finite differences to 1e-10 Ha/Bohr; comparison with QE vdw_corr='dft-d3' pending. [ADR](docs/decisions/0048-dftd3-dispersion.md).

items.feature: DFT+U, meta-GGA, hybrid functionals
items.note: Roadmap and validation oracles are in docs/research/xc-and-manybody-roadmap.md.

items.feature: Nonlinear core correction and PseudoDojo NC file support
items.note: Independent header checks and synthetic NLCC oracles; Si/MgO bulk smoke, comparison with QE pending. Datasets remain unqualified; ultrasoft and PAW unavailable. [Evidence](tests/reference/datasets/p13c-status.json).

items.feature: Atomic forces
items.note: NC LDA/PBE, NLCC, fixed spin and Fermi-Dirac, from a verified standard state (default) or a strict certified one; energy finite differences and independent scalar checks. DFT+U forces unsupported; comparison with QE pending. [Evidence](tests/reference/forces/manifest.json).

items.feature: Space-group symmetry (k-point reduction, density symmetrization)
items.note: Opt-in k-point reduction and density symmetrization; full/reduced, spin and finite-temperature checks. Magnetic spin swaps unsupported; comparison with QE pending. [Evidence](tests/reference/symmetry/evidence.json).

items.feature: Many-band NSCF, dielectric response and ACFDT–RPA correlation energy
items.note: Experimental `nscf`, `dielectric` and `rpa` workflows. The [R1–R3 comparisons](#rpa-building-blocks-many-bands-dielectric-constant-correlation-energy) apply to the tested settings and conventions.

items.feature: Atomic-orbital projection and Wannier90 file exchange
items.note: `subspace` projects plane-wave states onto localized orbitals and exports real-space hoppings. `wannier-export` writes inputs for external Wannier90, whose gauge can be read by `subspace`. [External comparison](tests/reference/response/r4/README.md) is pending.

items.feature: cRPA screened interaction parameters
items.note: The localized subspace is a building block. Screened U and J are not yet available. See the [RPA/cRPA roadmap](docs/roadmap/rpa-crpa-plan.md).

items.feature: Electronic-state landscape exploration: several self-consistent solutions, state comparison, branch tracking
items.note: Design in docs/roadmap/esle.md; starts after the baseline is complete.

items.feature: Self-consistent continuum solvation
items.note: The [standalone feasibility report](docs/research/extensible-dft/feasibility-report.md) and [integration design](docs/decisions/0061-typed-electrostatics-and-solvation-seam.md) are on main. An experimental SCF integration and synthetic test suite are on the [Gate 4 research branch](https://github.com/chaeeundad/baandi/tree/research/track-b-gate4-scf); solvation is not a main-branch feature.

items.feature: Mixed plane-wave and atomic-orbital (PW+AO) solver
items.note: The joint variational solver is [planned](docs/research/extensible-dft/decision-log.md#d-004--defer-track-a-mixed-basis--pwao--alb-behind-track-b--track-c-2026-11-28). Atomic-orbital projection works on plane-wave solutions; it does not change the SCF basis.

items.feature: External environments and multiscale coupling
items.note: Electrostatic embedding, QM/MM, MLIP coupling, explicit solvent and external fields are [design directions](docs/architecture/scientific-coupling.md).

items.feature: MPI distributed reference path
items.note: MPI is implemented behind a build feature; its distributed reference path is validated under documented gates. GPU remains a design topic with no implementation.

items.feature: GPU backends
items.note: GPU remains a design topic with no implementation.

items.feature: Standard convergence profile with fixed-point verification
items.note: Reference driver is the single production standard path with independent verification (ADR 0047). StrictOracle remains for explicit validation and the G4D exception. P17A numbers remain historical unverified legacy-profile evidence.

items.feature: Stress and pressure
items.note: NC frozen-basis strain derivatives from a verified standard state (default; stress inputs default to 5e-11 Ha, provisional) or a strict one; ASE strain check and separate Pulay estimate; real Si/MgO material stresses inconclusive; comparison with QE pending. [Evidence](tests/reference/stress/validation.json).

items.feature: Fixed-cell ionic relaxation
items.note: BFGS/FIRE and Cartesian constraints with reference SCF and live warm seeds. Optimizer resume restores optimizer state but currently lacks the reference orbital seed and records a fresh atomic-start fallback; historical byte-identical resume evidence belongs to the legacy path. CLI spin/FD relaxation remains unavailable. Gamma-only MgO is not bulk qualification; comparison with QE pending. [Evidence](tests/reference/relaxation/manifest.json).

items.feature: Cell relaxation
items.note: Variable-cell relaxation uses the reference driver with frozen Miller/FFT support and a final nominal-cutoff rebuild. Historical synthetic/isotropic Si/MgO rebuild-plus-polish evidence retains its original driver; gen19 reports reference/legacy lattice difference 6.3e-8 Bohr and pressure difference 2.3e-9 Ha/Bohr^3. Full-tensor shifted-mesh symmetry and cutoff convergence remain unestablished. Comparison with QE pending. [Historical evidence](tests/reference/relaxation/cell/validation.json); [gen19 relay and limits](docs/decisions/0047-reference-driver-single-path.md#evidence-gen14gen28).

items.feature: Molecular dynamics and phonons
items.note: Planned; not available yet.

can_today: Total energy, eigenvalues and electron density of insulating periodic systems with LDA or PBE, on Gamma or a k mesh.
Reproducible runs: the result files carry hashes, options and the energy audit.
not_yet: Validated magnetic and metallic material accuracy; DFT+U for correlated transition-metal oxides. Spin, NLCC and Fermi-Dirac options have limited validation below.
Spin-polarized or finite-temperature relaxation in the CLI, DFT+U forces, molecular dynamics, phonons and hybrid functionals.
speed: Current timing claims use the dated same-model tables and matched-condition protocol in docs/performance/comparison-rules.md and docs/performance/qe-vs-baandi-current.md. The 2026-11-05 relay describes earlier implementations and is not current reference-driver performance. Real-Gamma and MPI paths are implemented. No new speed measurement is supplied by this documentation update.
